title: Proud Father Holding Baby Girl by Classic Car, 1955 B&W Vintage Photo
description: A mid-1950s black-and-white square snapshot captures a smiling father holding his young baby girl on a sunny suburban sidewalk. The father wears a suit jacket and collared shirt, while the baby wears a bonnet headband and dress. Parked along the curb next to them is a classic 1950s automobile. The right border of the print displays the film processing timestamp 'AUG 55', illustrating mid-century post-war American family life.
